jordan: Heads-up — PR #8421 needs 2x LGTM before the 14:45 UTC cutoff. Tests are green, canary ran for 10m and looked healthy. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8421
preeti: grabbing a quick look now, thx for the ping.
liam: I can be one of the eyes — can someone confirm the small migration is reversible? @mae

liam: skimmed diffs — one tiny naming nit but non-blocking. leaving comment, will approve after.
preeti: found a minor logging typo, pushed a small fix to the branch. running CI again.
ci-bot: CI: re-run triggered by preeti — build #8421.2 pending.
preeti: CI is green again. approving now. LGTM.
mae: did a quick smoke on staging, warmup traces look correct. +1
liam: LGTM — approving.
jordan: great — that's 2x. I'll merge in ~2m and kick the patch deploy. ops-bot: please watch post-merge smoketest. :eyes:
